name: Warehouse view
summary: The Warehouse fleet in 3D, live: textured racks, the robots with their light strips, totes and routes, a heat map of waiting, KPIs, and controls that change the run.
help: Connect Live to the Warehouse fleet block's telemetry and Models to Warehouse models. While the run goes on, the robots move smoothly a couple of seconds behind the simulation (Behind real time); their light strip tells what they do: cyan to a pick face, amber picking (the rack lights the place), green carrying a tote to a station, violet at the station, red waiting for the way to clear. Routes draws the path each robot plans; Heat map colours where robots wait. The bar at the bottom sends commands to the run: order rate, robots, speed, pause, Block an aisle (then click an aisle; click it again to open it) and Open all. Click a robot to follow it, Cinematic for a slow orbit. When the run has ended, the whole run plays back with a timeline. Quality fast skips shadows and glow for slower computers.
